notes: Addresses, sizes and names only; no ROM bytes.
scope: in_scope = Astra's 412; ultralib_identified = 21 corpus-job functions (out of scope); stub_unclassified = 6 tiles under 16 bytes (identify only).
callees_tail / callers_tail count distinct jal targets inside 0x8000F3A4-0x800277D0; callees_static are jal targets below 0x8000F3A4.
hilo_refs are lui+lo16/ori pair values outside the tail text: KSEG0 data/BSS (0x80000400-0x803FFFFF) and KSEG1 hardware/uncached (0xA0000000-0xBFFFFFFF). Clustering leads, not verified symbols.
